description: Defines the DataObjects_Images class for interacting with the 'images' database table, including methods for fetching, deleting, generating unique filenames, auditing, and related image/banner associations within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: DataObjects_Images
classes.description: Represents the 'images' table with methods for data retrieval, deletion, filename management, auditing, and associations with banners.

methods.name: staticGet
methods.description: Retrieves a static instance of the object based on key and value.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches the next row into the object, handling PostgreSQL unescaping and portability options.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the current record, nullifying contents beforehand to avoid PostgreSQL issues.

methods.name: sequenceKey
methods.description: Overrides sequence handling for tables without autoincrement/sequence.

methods.name: getUniqueFileNameForDuplication
methods.description: Generates a unique filename by appending an incrementing suffix.

methods.name: _refreshUpdated
methods.description: Updates the 't_stamp' field with current UTC time.

methods.name: _auditEnabled
methods.description: Indicates auditing is enabled for this object.

methods.name: getOwningAccountIds
methods.description: Returns account IDs owning the image, based on associated banner or default admin account.

methods.name: _buildAuditArray
methods.description: Builds audit data, excluding binary contents and including banner info if updated.

methods.name: _formatValue
methods.description: Formats field value, returning 'binary data' for blob types.

methods.name: getBanner
methods.description: Retrieves the banner associated with this image, if any.
